articles.title: BOSGAME Launches Next-Generation AI PCs Built on AMD and Intel Platforms, Targeting High-Performance Compact Computing
articles.mainIdea: BOSGAME Launches Next-Generation AI PCs Built on AMD and Intel Platforms, Targeting High-Performance Compact Computing
articles.summary: PR Newswire: BOSGAME Launches Next-Generation AI PCs Built on AMD and Intel Platforms, Targeting High-Performance Compact Computing. BOSGAME, a technology-based electronic product brand, has officially announced the launch of two new AI PC models, the VTA-439 and VTI-490, marking a strategic move aligned with the latest technology roadmaps from both AMD and Intel. The new models are scheduled to become available globally in the first quarter of 2026. Related tickers mentioned: AMD, INTC.
